_note: Sound events (src/vfx/sfx.gd). label: when it plays (shown in the Klangwerkstatt); files: the variants of an event (one is picked at random, never the same twice in a row); category: bus and level group from audio_mix.json; volume_db: trim on top of the category (0 = the category level; every file is already levelled by its gain_db in audio_library.json); spread: random pitch range; pitch: fixed pitch factor; min_interval: shortest gap between two plays in seconds; with: another event that plays together with this one (a layer, e.g. a punch plus a grunt). src/variants/max_seconds are the first sound pass's cutting spec for scripts/prepare_sfx.js. Change the choices in the game's Klangwerkstatt (debug menu) or here.

story_attacks._note: The story worlds (src/hero/story_sound.gd, src/hell/hell_game.gd): which of the crypt attack sounds of this table each story attack uses. feedback.gd plays attack_<kind> when the attack fires and windup_<kind> (when it exists) while it winds up, like every crypt enemy. hell: the hell monsters act kinds (src/hell/hell_monsters.gd); moves: the Frostgruft enemy moves by move id, else by type (src/hell/frost_moves.gd, assets/data/combat_boss_moves.json); behaviors: the Frostgruft basic enemies; kits: the guardian kits (src/hell/boss_kit.gd). An empty kind stays silent (like the crypt blink). many: a volley of at least many_from shots sounds as this kind instead. These tables are the guardians' and bosses' kinds; regular monsters sound through mob below. mob: a regular monster (not a guardian, not a boss) never takes a crypt boss sound (an attack_<kind> of category boss: roar and slam are the crypt's minibosses', salve and beam the void boss's); summon (mob.keeps) stays, the crypt's necromancer summons too. Such a kind sounds as mob[group][name] (a volley as mob.many[group][name]), else as mob.any[kind]. telegraph_only: kit attacks that only wind up (their strikes land later). landings: hell monster zones that land like a crypt boss move (zone_burst: blast); landings_boss_only: only a guardian's or boss's landing blasts (the crypt's regular enemies never do). blast_gap: shortest gap in seconds between two landing blasts. moves_drop: direct sounds of the Frostgruft moves the crypt routing replaces besides their windup_ and attack_ sounds (the blink is silent like the crypt's, the ice armour sounds as move_fx). move_fx: a move type that raises this crypt fx event when it releases (feedback.gd shows and sounds it). rig_materials above also names the story monsters (hell ids, Frostgruft kinds, guardian looks) and is the one source of a story monster's sound material (theme mob materials are not read with the feel).
